title: East Timor Revisited: Ford, Kissinger and the Indonesian Invasion, 1975–76
publisher_or_archive: National Security Archive Electronic Briefing Book No. 62
summary: Declassified verbatim transcripts of the December 6, 1975 meeting in Jakarta between US President Gerald Ford, Secretary of State Henry Kissinger, and Indonesian dictator Suharto. When Suharto announced plans to take 'rapid or drastic action' in Portuguese Timor, Ford responded, 'We will understand and will not press you on the issue,' and Kissinger agreed, asking only that the attack occur after they returned to Washington.
